patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Cognism and LeadIQ share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Cognism and LeadIQ share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Cognism only if your buying job matches “Compliance-first B2B sales intelligence with phone-verified Diamond Data® mobiles, strong ” rather than LeadIQ's shape. Choose LeadIQ only if your buying job matches “Chrome/LinkedIn-adjacent capture and CRM sync with Universal Credits — Free 50 credits; Pr” rather than Cognism's shape. Workflow advantage: Cognism leans contact-management; LeadIQ leans lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Cognism and LeadIQ share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Cognism is Compliance-first B2B sales intelligence with phone-verified Diamond Data® mobiles, strong EMEA coverage, and CRM enrichment — quote-led Sale; LeadIQ is Chrome/LinkedIn-adjacent capture and CRM sync with Universal Credits — Free 50 credits; Pro from $200/mo..
- Company-size focus: Cognism (mid-market, enterprise) vs LeadIQ (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Cognism-leaning contact-management vs LeadIQ-leaning lead-management.
- Researched limits: Cognism — Not a native email sequencer — push contacts into Outreach/Salesloft or CRM for outreach; LeadIQ — Pro starts at $200/mo — higher entry than many SMB contact tools.

Limitations — Cognism: Not a native email sequencer — push contacts into Outreach/Salesloft or CRM for outreach; Sales Prospecting Standard/Pro list prices are not published on /pricing; LeadIQ: Pro starts at $200/mo — higher entry than many SMB contact tools; Native email sequencing depth is limited versus dedicated engagement platforms.

Poor-fit cases: Cognism is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a native email sequencer — push contacts into Outreach/Salesloft or CRM for outreach · LeadIQ is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Pro starts at $200/mo — higher entry than many SMB contact tools · Avoid Cognism if you actually need LeadIQ's motion (Chrome/LinkedIn-adjacent capture and CRM sync with Universal Credits — Free 50 c)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
